rounds.text: Valiant Organics Ltd is heavily mispriced by a market looking backward at stale sentiment rather than recognizing an explosive operational inflection [E71]. Recent financial figures reveal a staggering 1108% surge in trailing twelve-month compounded profit growth and a massive 275% year-on-year net profit expansion, backed by a stellar 97/100 results score [E21, E63, E71]. Crucially, capital expenditure is winding down as evidenced by Capital Work in Progress plunging by 68.2%, signifying that new manufacturing capacity is successfully coming online to drive future output [E39]. This operational scaling is already generating tangible cash, demonstrated by a strong cash conversion ratio of 1.29x alongside ₹ 44 Cr in operating cash flow and ₹ 11 Cr in free cash flow [E33, E34, E35]. Furthermore, the stock trades at an attractive price-to-book ratio of just 1.08x—substantially below the sector benchmark of 1.87x—while operating within a robust chemical sector tailwind score of 0.77 [E2, E7, E70]. Conceded: the long-term historical profile shows depressed return metrics and negative multi-year profit growth [E19, E26], but dismissing the ongoing turnaround ignores clear evidence of accelerating momentum [E71].
